sections.label: EFFECT
sections.html: Concentration maintains an effect that explicitly requires it. A character may normally maintain one Concentration effect; establishing another ends the previous one. Threads do not require Concentration merely to remain stored.

sections.label: UPKEEP
sections.html: Pay any printed upkeep at the end of your Turn. If you cannot or choose not to pay, Concentration and its maintained effect end at that upkeep step. There is no additional universal Focus cost.

sections.label: BREAK
sections.html: Whenever you suffer a Core Wound, burn 1 die from your currently available Action or Reaction Pool or end Concentration. If no appropriate die is available, Concentration ends. This payment is not a Reaction. A Temporary Wound absorbing the harm does not trigger it.

sections.label: ENDING
sections.html: You may voluntarily end Concentration for free during your own Turn. It ends immediately on unconsciousness or death (Dying alone does not end it), when its maintained effect expires, when the Encounter ends, or when an explicit disruption ends it.

sections.label: REMOVAL
sections.html: Effects that remove ordinary Conditions do not remove Specialty Conditions unless they explicitly say so.
